title: Concurrent collections and Channels
hook: A locked List is the wrong default once two threads touch it. ConcurrentDictionary and System.Threading.Channels give you maps and queues whose internals already use fine-grained synchronization.

sections.heading: Concurrent* types are not magic immunity
sections.prose: ConcurrentDictionary.GetOrAdd is atomic per call, but GetOrAdd(key, k => Expensive()) can still run Expensive twice if two threads miss. Pass a factory that is cheap, or single-flight a Task (next topic). ConcurrentQueue and ConcurrentBag drop the need for lock around Enqueue/TryDequeue. ConcurrentBag is thread-local optimized and unordered — wrong for FIFO RabbitMQ offload. BlockingCollection adds blocking Take; in async workers prefer Channel. Immutable collections give you snapshot publish with Interlocked.Exchange of the reference: readers never lock, writers replace the whole graph. Choose based on whether readers can see a slightly old map.

snippets.label: Channel as a RabbitMQ offload buffer
snippets.explanation: Producers never lock a List. Bound 256 applies backpressure instead of unbounded RAM when 999 users burst.

sections.heading: Channels versus IAsyncEnumerable
sections.prose: IAsyncEnumerable is a pull stream from one producer’s iterator. A Channel is a thread-safe buffer with one or many writers and readers. Use a channel when Kestrel threads must hand work to a dedicated SkiaSharp worker without blocking the request beyond WriteAsync. Complete the writer on shutdown so ReadAllAsync ends. Unbounded channels will eat the heap under a stampede; bounded plus Wait or DropWrite is a capacity decision you should name in the interview.

interviewTakeaways: GetOrAdd can still invoke the factory twice; that matters if the factory hits Redis.
Bounded Channel is backpressure; unbounded Channel is a hidden list.
ConcurrentBag is not a FIFO queue.
commonPitfalls: Using ConcurrentDictionary and then enumerating it while assuming a stable snapshot.
BlockingCollection.Take on an ASP.NET request thread.
Unbounded channels for CSV import buffers.

jsTsCorrelations.note: A JS array as a queue is safe on one thread. Across workers you need Atomics or a message channel. .NET Channel is the in-process analog of a worker message port with backpressure.
